title: Everton Faces Manchester United in Goal-Promising Duel
seoTitle: Everton vs Man Utd: High-Scoring Encounter Anticipated
subtitle: The match is set to be a spectacle of attacking prowess and tactical strategy.
excerpt: The clash between Everton and Manchester United, scheduled for Sunday, draws attention for its goal potential and each manager's strategy.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Everton and Manchester United, scheduled for Sunday, draws attention for its goal potential and each manager's strategy. The match could reveal the attacking strength of the Red Devils and the solid defense of David Moyes' team.

Goals Expected from Both Sides

Historically, Manchester United's games produce many goals. The club scored seven in their last match, and in five of the last six encounters, both teams scored. In the same period, Everton has also shown attacking capability, having scored and conceded in three of their last five games.

United's Attacking Strength and Dorgu's Possible Position Change

Michael Carrick, United's manager, revealed that Patrick Dorgu might take on the left-back position. The player, who has primarily played as a winger, has already demonstrated versatility in training and could be used as a full-back in Sunday's match.

Recent Transfers and Everton Reinforcements

Everton completed signings in the transfer window, including Christian Norgaard, Brennan Johnson, Ainsley Maitland-Niles, and Jack Grealish. The club also lost Iliman Ndiaye to Manchester City but still boasts a strengthened squad for the match.

Teams' Recent Performance

Everton enters the match with four points in the third round, occupying seventh position. The team won their League Cup match against Preston North End 4-0, boosting confidence. Manchester United, after their defeat to Hull City, regained momentum with a 5-2 victory over Ipswich Town.

Key Players to Watch

Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall, from Everton, stands out with an average of 2.5 shots per game in the Premier League and is considered the team's best outfield player. For United, Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans, and Carlos Baleba were the main acquisitions, with a total investment of 155 million pounds.

Expected Tactical Positioning

Everton is expected to rely on a defensive line of Tarkowski and Branthwaite, while United might use a formation with Lammens in goal, Dalot, Maguire, and Martinez in defense, and Mbeumo, Fernandes, and Dorgu in midfield. Carrick's strategy could involve Dorgu playing at full-back to maximize attacking width.

Current Outlook

The duel promises to be exciting, with both teams looking to overcome the opponent's defense and score goals. The transfer scenario, Dorgu's role, and the recent performance of key players are factors that could influence the final result.

With information from Goal.com, Manchester Evening News.
